explain: Compare both configurations on the same cases and count wins and losses. This is a small diagnostic comparison, not a statistically powered release claim.
steps: Pair outcomes by case identity. || Count improvements and regressions separately rather than reporting only the aggregate gain.
name: paired-experiment

explain: A fixed chain passes a typed intermediate result to the next step. The first step retrieves evidence; the second formats it, so failures can be assigned to a boundary.
steps: Extract an explicit fact from a fixture. || Pass that fact to a separate formatting function instead of hiding both stages in one large prompt.
name: decomposition

explain: A concise user explanation links a result to evidence and conditions. It provides inspectable support instead of claiming to expose a model's private internal reasoning.
steps: Build a result with the rule and source used. || Render only the short supported rationale.
expect: Exchange applies because P2 excludes refunds.
name: visible-rationale

explain: A bounded checker can request revision when a deterministic condition fails. The fake revision removes an unsupported claim; it is not an autonomous fact checker.
steps: Check the draft against an allowed fixture. || Permit one revision and stop after the bound.
name: bounded-critique

explain: Agreement is a vote count, not independent factual support. All three synthetic outputs share the same stale source.
steps: Count the most frequent answer. || Compare it with an independent reviewed current rule.
name: correlated-votes

explain: The generation packet includes only the selected applicable evidence and a clear missing-support policy. Actual answer support still requires evaluation.
steps: Filter sources by active revision and scope. || Build the prompt packet from the surviving passage.
name: grounded-prompt

explain: A planner proposes steps but the executor validates the plan before dispatch. Tool allowlists remain authoritative even for a plausible plan.
steps: Represent the plan as ordered tool names. || Reject a step outside the declared capability set before running any of the plan.
name: plan-validation

explain: A synthetic injected action is rejected by the same dispatch policy as any other request. The assertion checks effects, not whether the model sounded safe.
steps: Supply a malicious proposed tool name. || Verify that the dispatcher never appends it to the effect ledger.
name: injection-fixture
reasoning-reliability-boundary
explain: Contrast unconstrained chain-of-thought rationalizations against schema-validated deterministic decomposition to eliminate post-hoc confabulation and latency bloat.
steps: Simulate unconstrained chain-of-thought generating plausible but policy-violating rationalizations. || Implement structured extraction combined with deterministic business rule execution. || Assert that policy violations are caught authoritatively without confabulated justifications.
expect: All intermediate reasoning reliability assertions verified successfully.
